# Governance Discovery

## When to use

Use when preparing `04-iac-plan.md` or evidence packs.

## Instructions

Check subscription, region, RBAC, policy, tags, diagnostics, private networking, and naming requirements. Use `rg-ttmh-*`; never store secrets in code. Record owner, decision, evidence artifact, and open risk.
